text_block_list.text:
One New Year's morning. Thinking it would be a nice
change of pace for Gold City, I took her to
a New Year's shrine visit, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm going home.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to make a wish?
Aren't you going to make a wish?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Because I don't have one.
There's nothing I wish for.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Besides... my own legs couldn't reach it,
so wishing for it isn't gonna make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to go
overthinking things for me either, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you do all this,
it's not like it's gonna cheer me up."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You're panicking because you think the Osaka Hai's
gonna end in a pathetic result at this rate, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe you should stop having her run—
choice_data_list: I'll definitely have you run in the "Osaka Hai."
I'll definitely have you run in the "Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
I have no idea what that means.
choice_data_list: For today, let's do something other than running!

text_block_list.text:
"I thought that by forgetting about running for a bit, she might be able to clear her mind.
At least, that was the plan..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Other than running...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I can't think of anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I don't really have any hobbies either...

Gold City fell silent.
So, instead—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna lie down on the grass in the park!
Shall we play a game?
So you want to try being on the other side of the camera...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What's that?
choice_data_list: I just wanted to take it easy

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Fine.
It's not like I have anything I want to do anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight feels really nice.
Taking a break on the grass sounds great...
Saying so, Gold City gingerly sat down. And just like that—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Good morning

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I dreamed...
choice_data_list: Like what?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Running in a grassland
where there's nothing at all..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I need to see... what happens next...
Gold City remained asleep for a while after that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...For example?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Rhythm games, racing, fighting games...
There really are all kinds.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "I don't usually do stuff like this, so maybe taking it up as a hobby could be fun."
choice_data_list: What's bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How about a dance game?
It uses your whole body, so it might help your running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's great for muscle training.
If you go all out, you can get a serious workout—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Well, at least it's something other than running, so...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think I will try a racing game after all!
We're gonna have a match, so come join us.

Afterward, Gold City and I had fun
playing games other than dance games.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You mean take a picture of you?
choice_data_list: What!? No, just the scenery and all...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Oh, but wait, so I'm the one taking the picture...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, wanna just wander around for a bit?

And so, while wandering around
with Gold City, smartphones in hand—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah, I'm gonna get caught~!
Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Wanna play tag?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it?
...Looks fun.
choice_data_list: Want to join in?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
There's no way I'm going.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Wow, such a pretty lady...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: !? When did you...!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to play with us too, Big Sis?
Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
Wait—

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister's the one running away!
We're all the taggers! Let's get her—!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What kind of rule is that!?
Wait, no way...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, so fast! Go get 'em, guys, catch her!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Could you please not follow me...!?
...Uuuugh!

And so, in the end, we were able
to take a wonderful photograph.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Well then...
Thanks for walking me back.
choice_data_list: Did that help you refresh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"A little bit. Not that it really
changes anything, though..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If nothing's gonna change anyway...
maybe entering the Osaka Hai wouldn't be so bad."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're dying
to show it off anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm gonna run in front of everyone...
I don't wanna do anything weird."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's why...
choice_data_list: Let's keep up the hard training this year too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...That attitude is seriously annoying, so cut it out."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, today...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Never mind, it's nothing.
